script_text:
Get ready, Taurus, an Earth sign—this week Venus and Mars will shake love and money unexpectedly.
Monday's Mars square to Venus in 12th House creates jealousy, worst day for romance.
Tuesday Venus sextiles Jupiter in 7th House brightens partnership prospects.
Wednesday is your day as Venus enters your 5th House, igniting passion and flings.
Mid‑week, Mercury‑Pluto conjunction in your 2nd House forces a financial check.
Thursday's trine Mercury to Neptune in 10th House clears confusion, perfect for career and money.
Friday's opposition Venus in 5th House and Uranus in 11th House brings romance surprises.
Weekend ends with a Saturn sextile to Moon in your 4th House, grounding you.
Your best day is Wednesday, Venus enters your 5th House, igniting romance.
Your worst day is Monday, due to Mars square, causing covert conflict.
Advice: focus on practical career moves while letting love play lightly on Thursday.
Follow for daily updates.
